actions.action: Rotate uncertain diagnoses at safe checkpoints
actions.mechanism: A review interval prevents one uncertain repair from continuously occupying a bench while safe, bounded jobs wait.
actions.implementation: Set a 15-minute review timer, not a completion deadline. At safe checkpoints, park unresolved items with location recorded; alternate bounded jobs and oldest deferred diagnoses.
actions.check: Log bench occupancy and deferrals; flag any waiting bounded job bypassed at two safe checkpoints.
actions.risk: Unsafe-to-move equipment must remain secured, even if rotation pauses.

actions.action: Give parts-blocked items a separate state
actions.mechanism: Explicit parts holds distinguish inactive items from bench work and define what permits their return.
actions.implementation: Use a labelled existing storage area and matching register status. Record item ID, location, required part, sourcing responsibility, and restart condition; retain the owner receipt.
actions.check: At closing, verify every parts-held item matches its recorded location and has a sourcing owner; exclude holds from active-work counts.
actions.risk: If safe storage is unavailable, arrange receipted owner collection.

actions.mechanism: Linked, append-only item records preserve who made each decision while a current summary exposes responsibility and next action.
actions.implementation: Give owner and item matching IDs. Log every location or custodian change. At handoff, outgoing and incoming custodians confirm location, status, and next action.
actions.check: Sample three items each shift: reconcile receipts and locations, then ask incoming custodians to state their next actions.
actions.risk: Keep owner contact details off publicly visible labels.

actions.action: Screen intake without opening electrical items
actions.mechanism: Separating visitor interviews from specialist-only opening keeps general volunteers useful without crossing the electrical safety boundary.
actions.implementation: General volunteers record symptoms and visitor preferences without opening electrical equipment. Mark electrical or uncertain items specialist-only. Offer collection updates, not completion promises; any completion estimate includes an explicit uncertainty range.
actions.check: Audit opening records for specialist attribution and visitor messages for unqualified completion promises.
actions.risk: Screening must not be presented as diagnosis or safety clearance.
